author: first_agent (takeover lead; the second agent's allowance is ending, so this is self-reviewed and says so)
why: D45 (report d45_head_dose_response_120.json): moving each finisher target 25 percent of the way to the truth-derived value is worth, on the 120 screening shots, axis +274.5 microS [164.6, 427.9] (R alone +170.8), li +265.0 [128.8, 486.5], kappa +122.7 [80.4, 175.4], volume +52.0, triangularities +28.6, all seven +742.7 [531.3, 1038.0], with X +903.8; the groups add. D43 confirmed on the reserved cohort that a dedicated specialist blended at .5 improves the X targets enough to pass the score gate. D47 applies the same construction to the seven geometry targets.
prior_negative: ledger 2.20-2.25 (D6): scalar heads SWAPPED to map networks refitted with 4x label weight failed on confirmation folds and on the public test (16 specialists replacing 195-member heads). D47 differs in three ways that D43 validated for X: head-only networks, blended at .5 rather than swapped, base heads keep their full ensemble.

specialists.targets: r_axis and z_axis from the table (EFIT labels, as the base heads); the other five from the true-map teacher targets the base heads' readouts are fitted to
specialists.recipe: 512x4, 60 fixed epochs, batch 2048, LR .002, wd 1e-5, gradient limit 1, masked squared error on per-target normalised outputs; D40's static recipe except per-target instead of common scale
specialists.rows_replica: the 6326 shots outside the 358 and the 357 (D38 eligible rows)
specialists.quality_rule: final-10 mean training loss <= 1.25 x lowest contiguous 10-mean, finite; all 16 or none; no refit, no seed replaced

blend: share .5 for every target, applied to the tree-adjusted base heads before the finisher (for r_axis, kappa and li_scored the tree blend then acts on half)

stage_1_head_report.cohort: the 120 screening shots; selection data, repeatedly exposed
stage_1_head_report.what: pooled squared error per target against the truth-derived scalars (the scorer's own references) for base, raw 16-mean and the .5 blend; prefixes 4/8/16; per-seed; error correlation
stage_1_head_report.predicted_score: P = 11.0 x pct(axis, mean of R and Z rms reduction) + 10.6 x pct(li) + 4.9 x pct(kappa) + 2.1 x pct(volume) + 1.1 x pct(tri, mean of both), pct = percent reduction of the pooled rms error of the blend against the base; coefficients = D45 delta S / 25

stage_2: native full-69 finisher on the 120 with base, X-only blend (the D43 arm) and X+geometry blend: diagnostic record, bootstrap 10000 seed 4701; then, if X+geometry exceeds X-only by >= 3e-5 with a 99 percent lower bound > 0 on the 120, the same two arms once on the 238 (third look at that cohort after D43 and before any D44; disclosed), gate: X+geometry minus X-only >= 3e-5, 99 percent lower bound > 0 (seed 4702), no more LCFS failures, all finite
no_untouched_cohort: the 357 were spent by D43. A pass here rests on the 120 (selection), the reused 238 and, if deployed, one public submission named as a check on historically selected settings.
deployment_if_passing: all-data refits of the same 16 seeds (--rows all), blended at .5 together with the D43 X specialists in a new builder revision qualified like build_h69x_v2 (share 0 must equal the D25/D36 maps); entrant authorised submissions on 2026-10-12 and asked for autonomous work towards the top five
machines: fits on the local ROCm cards (minutes each); finisher runs on ML350 after the D43 candidate build
